feed.headline: Iceland votes against restarting EU membership talks
feed.ai: Broadcaster RUV reports that 52.8% of voters rejected the government's proposal to resume accession talks.

feed.headline: Memory wars: Election clash over Germany's Nazi past as AfD eyes power in east
feed.ai: Remembering its role in the World Wars is a key aspect of modern Germany's identity but the AfD argues it is time to take a more positive view of the past.

feed.headline: Why is Ukraine's ex-defence minister calling for wartime elections?
feed.ai: Mykhailo Fedorov has called for elections, without addressing concerns over how they could be held while at war.

feed.headline: Ukrainian Drone Mastermind, Fired by Kyiv, Will Advise Italy’s Defense Chief
feed.ai: The appointment of Mykhailo Fedorov, a Ukrainian former defense minister, showed how other militaries are racing to adapt to battlefield changes accelerated by the war in Ukraine.

feed.headline: Spanish Leader Says 5,000 Migrants Are Still in Ceuta, Weeks After Border Surge
feed.ai: Their continued presence has roiled the Spanish territory in Africa and heaped pressure on Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez.

feed.headline: Far Right Is Poised to Win in a German State, but Fight Over Power Won’t End There
feed.ai: State and federal leaders are trying to avoid sharing sensitive intelligence with the Alternative for Germany should it take power in a state’s elections next week.

feed.headline: Milo Yiannopoulos, Right-Wing Agitator, Deported Home to U.K.
feed.ai: Mr. Yiannopoulos, an early supporter of President Trump and vocal supporter of mass deportations, was himself sent back to his home country, part of a long fall from right-wing grace.

feed.headline: 37 Killed After Russian Strike on Weapons Depot as Ukraine Blames Negligence
feed.ai: The depot, which was in a civilian area near Kyiv, “definitely shouldn’t have been there,” President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

feed.headline: Why Iceland and Others Might Want In, Not Out, of the E.U. Club
feed.ai: A few years ago, some feared the European Union was going out of style. Now Iceland is mulling membership alongside a long list of candidates.

feed.headline: Icelanders react as the EU referendum results come in
feed.ai: Icelanders react as voters reject a proposal to restart European Union accession talks in a closely contested referendum.

feed.headline: Shootings surge as drug gangs torment Brussels
feed.ai: This year alone there have been more than 65 shootings in the Belgian capital, as drug crime soars.

feed.headline: Iceland holds knife-edge referendum on EU - and it could be decided on fish
